title: Learning to Learn from Multimodal Experience
abstract: arXiv:2605.16857v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multimodal agents increasingly interact with real-world-like environments and generate rich trajectories spanning perception, reasoning, and action. A key research focus is how to transform these raw multimodal trajectories into reusable experience that can improve future task performance. Existing experience-driven learning methods are mostly developed in textual settings and typically rely on manually designed memory schemas, making them less effective for multimodal experience that requires composing heterogeneous signals across modalities, temporal scales, and abstraction levels. We propose AutoMMemo, a general framework that enables agents to automatically design memory mechanisms for learning from multimodal experience. AutoMMemo represents each memory mechanism as an executable memo program, which defines how past episodes are stored, organized, and retrieved. translated_title: 学习如何从多模态经验中学习
translated_abstract: 多模态智能体日益与类真实世界环境进行交互，并生成涵盖感知、推理与行动的丰富轨迹。一个关键的研究焦点是如何将这些原始的多模态轨迹转化为可复用的经验，以提升未来的任务表现。现有的经验驱动学习方法大多是在文本环境中开发的，且通常依赖人工设计的记忆模式，这使得它们在处理需要在模态、时间尺度和抽象层级上组合异构信号的多模态经验时效果欠佳。我们提出了AutoMMemo，一个通用框架，使智能体能够自动设计用于从多模态经验中学习的记忆机制。AutoMMemo将每个记忆机制表示为一个可执行的备忘程序，该程序定义了过去情节如何被存储、组织和检索。它通过一个迭代过程来发现有效的备忘程序（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出AutoMMemo通用框架，通过将记忆机制表示为可执行的备忘程序并迭代发现有效程序，使智能体能够自动设计记忆机制，从而从多模态经验中学习。
en_tdlr: AutoMMemo is a general framework that enables agents to automatically design memory mechanisms, represented as executable memo programs discovered through an iterative process, for learning from multimodal experience.
